question: How many members are nominated by the President to the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The President of India has the authority to nominate **12 members** to the Rajya Sabha.
 
• These nominated members are chosen for their **expertise in various fields** such as literature, science, art, and social service.
 
• This provision is under **Article 80 of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• The purpose of these nominations is to ensure that the Rajya Sabha benefits from the experience and specialized knowledge of distinguished individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajya Sabha**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• It represents the states and union territories of the country.
 
• The Rajya Sabha has a maximum membership of 250 members.
 
• Out of these, 238 members are elected by the states and union territories, while 12 are nominated by the President.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution, but one-third of its members retire every two years.
 
 
 
• **Article 80 of the Indian Constitution**
 
 
• This article deals with the composition of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• It specifies the maximum number of members, the method of election, and the nomination of members by the President.
 
• Under this article, the President nominates 12 members who have special knowledge or practical experience in various fields such as literature, science, art, and social service.
 
 
 
• **Nominated Members**
 
 
• The nominated members bring diverse expertise to the Rajya Sabha.
 
• They are not bound by party lines and can contribute independently to debates and legislation.
 
• Some notable nominated members include Lata Mangeshkar (singer), Sachin Tendulkar (cricketer), and Raghunath Mohapatra (sculptor).
